changelog.summary: Adds workflow goal, metric, and workflow-boundary guidance plus Technical, Architecture, and Strategic Pulse focus recommendations.

title: Browser Performance Validation
description: Measure approved browser pages and journeys against customer-defined budgets with comparable samples and durable diagnostics.
setup_prompt: Use Browser Performance Validation with my browser foundation. Preserve my environment and budgets, collect comparable samples for approved pages or journeys, retain redacted diagnostics, and report regressions without changing thresholds.

setup_inputs.label: Browser, device, network, and cache profile
Metrics, budgets or baseline, and decision policy
Warmup, sample count, and variance policy

recommended_tools.name: Playwright CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Run controlled journey timing and browser metric collection

recommended_tools.name: Lighthouse CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Collect supported page-level performance diagnostics when compatible with the environment

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Investigate regressions and collect supported network, console, video, and trace evidence

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Sample comparability, metric validity, and diagnostic completeness
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Measurement profiles, journey reuse, evidence storage, and report design
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Whether measured journeys and budgets reflect customer impact
Usefulness of performance signals for release decisions
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
